title: Demo substitute save bypasses the §8.3 validation: an empty save wipes the referee contact and reports success
evidence: demo_update: RefcheckEditSubstitute -> fire_demo_refcheck_substitute(model, call_id, edit.name, edit.email, edit.phone)  // no validation; demo_store: "substitute" -> { let call = ReferenceCallDetail(..call, contact_name: opt_str(name)) ... }  // opt_str("") = None. Real path (client.gleam:7427-7454, unreachable because the demo arm intercepts first): case name { "" -> ... error: Some(copy.refcheck_edit_need_name) ... case email, phone { "", "" -> ... error: Some(copy.refcheck_edit_need_channel). The substitute form starts EMPTY (reference_panel.gleam:1094: RefcheckEditSubstitute -> #("", "", "", False, None)) and a-tom's rows offer it (hooks(True, True, True, True)).
detail: Saving the substitute form with empty fields succeeds in demo and sets contact_name/email/phone to None — a state the real product forbids — while firing the success toast. Diverges from the real flow on a clickable demo surface.
recommended_fix: Mirror save_refcheck_edit's validation in the demo UserSavedRefcheckEdit arm (name required, email-or-phone required) before firing the store mutation.

title: demo_not_in_demo_toast and add_toast allocate the same toast id — first timeout dismisses both
evidence: demo_update.gleam: let toast_id = model.next_toast_id + 1 ... next_toast_id: toast_id  // vs client.gleam add_toast: let id = model.next_toast_id ... next_toast_id: id + 1
detail: After a demo toast (id n+1, next=n+1), the next response-handler toast via add_toast also gets id n+1. The demo toast's 5s AppDismissToast(n+1) removes both. Reachable: pay-surface toast then a status-change success toast within 5s. Still present since r2 (#25).
recommended_fix: Match add_toast's convention (id = next_toast_id, next = id + 1) or route demo toasts through the shared add_toast.

title: Reset/logout don't clear open_dispatched — after Reset, reopened Submitted applications never auto-transition to UnderReview
evidence: reset_demo's Model(..model, ...) resets vacancy_detail/leaderboard/application_detail/comparison_details/archived_vacancies/awaiting_list/notifications/toasts — open_dispatched absent (model.gleam:747-766 clear_demo_state also omits it). should_dispatch_open: case status { application.Submitted -> !set.contains(open_dispatched, application_id); _ -> False }
detail: a-sara and a-ciara are seeded "submitted". First open fires mark_opened (UnderReview + audit row). Reset re-seeds them Submitted but the ids stay in open_dispatched, so reopening never re-fires — they stay Submitted forever, diverging from the real first-open behavior the demo showcases.
recommended_fix: Clear open_dispatched in reset_demo and clear_demo_state (the demo store is re-seeded, so the dispatch dedup set must be too).

title: id_suffix truncation guarantees id/short_code collisions for same-prefix property names
evidence: let id = "v-demo-" <> suffix ... short_code: "RTDEMO" <> suffix  // id_suffix: case string.length(cleaned) { n if n <= 8 -> cleaned; n -> string.drop_end(cleaned, n - 8) }
detail: Creating two demo vacancies whose names share an 8-char cleaned prefix (or the same name twice) yields duplicate ids. find_vacancy returns the first; update/archive/close mutate BOTH (list.map on id ==). Still present since r2 (#27); the comment promises non-collision it doesn't deliver.
recommended_fix: Append a per-store counter (e.g. vacancy count) to the suffix in create_vacancy.

title: Reminder/bulk-invite results are hardcoded and mutate nothing — counts contradict the seeded awaiting list
evidence: pub fn send_reminder(store, _vacancy_id) -> #(DemoStore, #(Int, Int)) { #(store, #(2, 1)) }  // remind_applicant -> #(store, #(1, 0)); the v-maples awaiting fixture has 3 rows with reminded: False on exactly one (emma.doyle, line 887) and reminded: True on the other two
detail: Send-reminder toast claims 2 sent / 1 failed against a list showing one remindable applicant, and no reminded flag ever flips — the row still offers Remind after a 'sent' toast. Still present since r2 (#24).
recommended_fix: Derive the counts from the awaiting fixture and flip reminded/followed_up in the store (or return counts matching the seed).
